Siadenovirus._provenance: TAdV-3 NC_001958 is a PROVISIONAL RefSeq -- 'has not yet been subject to final NCBI review' -- identical to AF074946, the authors' own submission. Its gene boundaries were set by COMPUTATIONAL homology comparison with other adenoviruses (PMID_claude_generated 9791022), not measured. Experimental transcript boundaries exist only in the 2026 RACE map (PMID_claude_generated 41960683).

Barthadenovirus._provenance: OAdV-7 NC_004037. The genome paper is PMID_claude_generated 8659111 (1996), which also reports proteinase cleavage sites measured on purified virions. Transcription start sites and splice junctions for the lefthand end, IVa2, E2, P32K and E4 regions were mapped EXPERIMENTALLY (PMID_claude_generated 9614874); the right-hand RH transcripts in PMID_claude_generated 12504581.

_WARNING: These are DATABASE annotations, NOT literature boundaries. GenBank/RefSeq records carry the same kind of errors as BV-BRC: a /product= or a join() is a submitter's claim with at most a curation pass over it. Demonstrated in this very family: NC_004037 annotates the LH3 locus as 'E1B 55K' and atadenoviruses have no E1B at all. Use this file ONLY as a consistency check -- does a collection hold one gene, or two mixed -- and never as the authority for a boundary. Literature evidence, graded, is in each module's LITERATURE_INVENTORY.md.
